tasks.title: Confirm kickoff baseline and decision ownership
acceptance: Review both sources and reconcile scope against this structure.
Identify product deciders and record ambiguities without approving them.
Confirm capacity and sequence or retain undated sprint proposals.
validation: Source-to-backlog review; planning validator; record outstanding decisions.

tasks.title: Define persona flows, states and reference audit
acceptance: Write success, denied, error and retry paths for all personas.
Inspect current public references and record sources; do not invent comparisons.
Define navigation, wireframes and applicable screen states.
validation: Review flows against PRD and implementation-plan section 7.

tasks.title: Define architecture, policy seams and API contracts
acceptance: Document services, repositories, DTOs and permission matrix.
Specify current-assignment concurrency, retry and storage lifecycle contracts.
Keep undecided behavior disabled; reconcile parcel-code pages with assignment-ID APIs.
validation: Review section 6 endpoints, privacy boundaries and dependency direction.

tasks.title: Initialize pinned toolchain, local services and CI
acceptance: Verify official version compatibility and pin stack with lockfile.
Provide reproducible local PostgreSQL setup and environment validation.
Wire real lint/typecheck/unit/build checks; add database/browser checks when infrastructure exists.
validation: Fresh pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; pnpm lint; pnpm typecheck; pnpm test:unit; pnpm build.

tasks.title: Build accessible tokens, primitives and persona shells
acceptance: Use Sora and documented proposed tokens without inventing brand approval.
Build reusable form/status primitives and persona shells without business logic.
Verify keyboard focus, mobile widths and loading/error/empty states.
validation: Component tests; a11y smoke; reviewed mobile/desktop screenshots; lint/typecheck/build.

tasks.title: Implement policy-neutral schema and integrity boundaries
acceptance: Separate staff identity and driver records; preserve audit references.
Enforce unique parcel/tracking fields, FKs and a single current assignment.
Avoid unapproved defaults/transitions; document later policy-dependent migrations.
validation: Fresh migration; uniqueness, FK and current-assignment integrity integration checks.

tasks.title: Create isolated fixtures and database test harness
acceptance: Use synthetic admin, two drivers, assigned/unassigned/reassigned parcels.
Isolate test database and prevent destructive execution on production.
Wire real integration scripts and CI database lifecycle.
validation: Fresh migrate/seed; repeated isolated integration runs; reset safety review.

tasks.title: Implement approved staff sessions and provisioning
acceptance: Use established compatible auth and approved internal provisioning.
Link authenticated driver identity to driver record; no public signup.
Implement approved recovery/disable/session rules without custom crypto.
validation: Session integration; invalid/no-session cases; CSRF checks on cookie mutations.

tasks.title: Enforce role and object authorization
acceptance: Protect admin services and restrict drivers to current owned objects.
Deny no-session, wrong-role and cross-driver reads/writes without private leakage.
Provide ownership checks reusable at commit time.
validation: Service-level unauthorized matrix including calls bypassing UI.

tasks.title: Deliver driver create/list/detail/edit
acceptance: Validate required name/contact/vehicle type/number server-side and in forms.
Persist/display valid records and edit allowed business fields.
Expose valid drivers for assignment; add no deletion/deactivation workflow.
validation: Form/unit/API/DB checks; admin create/edit E2E; wrong-role denials.

tasks.title: Deliver parcel creation and unique codes
acceptance: Persist sender/recipient/address and approved payment/initial-status data atomically.
Generate separate unique parcel/tracking fields with collision recovery.
Display codes for manual copy; preserve invalid form input.
validation: Prepaid/COD tests; code collisions; rollback; parcel-create E2E.

tasks.title: Complete admin parcel reads and validation UX
acceptance: Provide authorized list/detail matching saved data.
Add no unapproved parcel editing or automated communication.
Verify keyboard error focus, pending/copy feedback and retry recovery.
validation: Read/API permission tests; responsive form review; admin E2E.

tasks.title: Prepare notification event and recipient interfaces
acceptance: Define preference/instruction/assignment events and transactional writer seam.
Specify resolver/dedup contract without guessing production recipients.
Disable unapproved transport/read-state behavior; no external queues.
validation: Contract tests with explicit test-only policies; list pending production scenarios.

tasks.title: Deliver manual-date assignment and reassignment
acceptance: Assign valid parcel/driver with explicit assign/delivery dates; list omits photo.
Reassign current ownership atomically with approved driver notifications.
Handle concurrent admins safely and preserve history/status; no automatic date math.
validation: DB concurrency and stale-owner tests; admin assign/reassign E2E.

tasks.title: Deliver dated driver worklist and parcel detail
acceptance: Filter by date and current authenticated driver; show required list/detail fields.
Copy phone accessibly and preserve selected date on navigation.
Display nullable preferences/instructions without invented defaults or route maps.
validation: Date/ownership integration; copy interaction; mobile E2E and denied direct URLs.

tasks.title: Prepare result, mapping and storage policy interfaces
acceptance: Define exact driver labels and injectable mapping/photo policies.
Specify private staged uploads and cleanup on persistence failure.
Specify idempotency and stale-owner contracts; no production result behavior enabled.
validation: Policy/interface tests with explicit test-only rules; unresolved scenarios remain pending.

tasks.title: Implement approved private photo storage
acceptance: Enforce approved types/size/count/status-specific requirements server-side.
Authorize uploads and short-lived driver/admin reads appropriately.
Bind metadata to parcel/assignment and handle failure/orphan cleanup.
validation: Storage-emulator integration; unauthorized/expired reads; invalid uploads/failure recovery.

tasks.title: Deliver atomic result, mapped status and photo detail
acceptance: Persist result/status/history/actor/time/photo consistently.
Recheck ownership at commit and handle retries without duplicate results.
Show authorized photo only in admin detail; failed writes leave public status unchanged.
validation: Rollback/idempotency/stale-assignment race tests; driver E2E; admin photo access.

tasks.title: Deliver safe latest public tracking
acceptance: Valid code returns correct approved minimal DTO; invalid code gives recoverable error.
Show latest committed mapped status without stale-cache leakage.
Rate-limit enumeration and redact codes/private data in logs.
validation: DTO negative assertions; invalid/rate-limit tests; result-to-tracking E2E including failed save.

tasks.title: Implement approved customer edit proof and eligibility
acceptance: Enforce approved proof, parcel scope, expiry/revocation and edit-state rules.
Validate instruction content/length; tracking-code possession alone grants no implicit edit rights.
Denied/locked requests have no mutation or private disclosure.
validation: Forged/expired/wrong-parcel proof; lock boundaries; invalid text tests.

tasks.title: Deliver receiving options and instructions with alerts
acceptance: Offer exactly three PRD options and explicit save/current state.
Persist authorized change and correct driver notification atomically.
Preserve failed input and show locked/saved states; no accounts or external messaging.
validation: Authorized/denied integration; rollback/dedup; preference E2E and driver detail refresh.

tasks.title: Deliver driver notification bell/list/filters
acceptance: List only authorized notifications with required parcel/customer fields.
Filter date/code and open the correct currently authorized parcel.
Apply approved reassignment visibility/read state; stale links leak nothing.
validation: Trigger/recipient/dedup/filter integration; notification E2E and cross-driver denial.

tasks.title: Implement approved expected delivery date
acceptance: Use approved sign/day type/inclusivity/weekend/holiday policy.
Keep scheduled date separate from calculated expected date.
Document date/timezone presentation and boundary examples.
validation: Month/year/leap and holiday policy tests; assignment date UI verification.

tasks.title: Verify cross-persona acceptance and security failures
acceptance: Verify every included PRD criterion against real persistence.
Cover roles, retries, failed upload/DB, concurrent reassignment and status freshness.
Record actual results and keep unresolved defects visible.
validation: Full lint/typecheck/unit/integration/build; persona and security Playwright suites.

tasks.title: Complete accessibility, responsive and observed UX review
acceptance: Review all plan viewports and applicable critical states.
Verify keyboard/screen-reader/zoom/contrast and reviewed screenshots.
Run actual participant/proxy studies per plan; resolve blocking findings.
validation: Real a11y runner; visual review; assistive-tech evidence and participant observations.

tasks.title: Verify operational targets and recovery
acceptance: Measure approved operational targets and state measurement limits.
Rehearse migration, backup/restore and rollback with nonproduction data.
Document secure config/retention and enforce required CI checks.
validation: Production-build performance/load smoke; restore/rollback rehearsal; CI evidence.

tasks.title: Record release acceptance and Codex handoff
acceptance: Link code/tests/evidence for every PRD ID and identify deferred scope.
Record release recommendation and risks without implying deployment approval.
Provide reproducible commands and next safe task.
validation: Planning validator; source-to-release review; evidence and unresolved-defect audit.

acceptance: Render responsive coming-soon landing page without fake tracking functionality.
Build and typecheck successfully.
Deploy to Vercel and verify returned URL.
validation: Vercel production next build (includes TypeScript check)
